card.title: Idempotent Payments With an Idempotency Key

a1.cap: Mobile clients retry POST /api/payments when the network drops, which must never charge twice. Require an Idempotency-Key header: the first request with a key is processed; any retry with the same key returns the original result without charging again, even if two retries arrive at the same time.

lines: Mobile clients retry POST /api/payments when the network drops, which must never charge twice. Require an Idempotency-Key header: the first request with a key is processed; any retry with the same key returns the original result without charging again, even if two retries arrive at the same time.

a1.cap: Keep a map from idempotency key to the payment result. computeIfAbsent atomically runs the charge only for the first request with a key; concurrent duplicates wait and receive the same stored result.
a1.say: Keep a map from idempotency key to the payment result. compute If Absent atomically runs the charge only for the first request with a key; concurrent duplicates wait and receive the same stored result.

a1.cap: In production this map lives in a database table with a unique constraint on the key, plus an expiry policy.
The client generates a unique key per logical payment and resends it on every retry. A missing header gets a 400 automatically.
computeIfAbsent runs the lambda at most once per key, even when duplicates race.
a1.say: compute If Absent runs the lambda at most once per key, even when duplicates race.

a1.cap: The real charge happens only inside that once-per-key block.
Retries get the stored result, the same payment id, without a second charge.
